edits.headline: Teen charged over alleged racist threats to Indian family in Brisbane
edits.subheadline: The 19-year-old allegedly threatened to blow up the family's residential building, Gulf News reported.
editorialBody: A 19-year-old man was charged after an alleged racist attack on an Indian family in Morningside, in Brisbane's east, Gulf News reported. He allegedly abused the family and threatened to blow up their residential building, and the family was considering returning to India, the paper said.
In New Delhi, worshippers at the Race Course mosque, near the Prime Minister's residence, fear it will be demolished after its power and water were cut, The Quint reported.
